decision: D1 BLEND REPAIR (ruled): today's [36,72] averages two cane types. ERECT is the default (spec §10.1): clemson_hgic blackberry "Erect varieties should be planted 2 to 4 feet apart in the row and 10 feet between rows." -> in_row [24,48], rows [120,120]. The same page's semi-trailing sentence ('6 to 8 feet apart in the row, with rows 10 feet apart') waits on plant_habit (R4; not this promote). Corroborating: UC MG SLO 3-4 ft in-row, 8-10 ft rows; USU erect 5 ft. Trellis-post spacing excluded. Restatements: the two planting_method rows 'rows 8 to 10 feet apart' -> 'rows about 10 feet apart' (Clemson states 10 ft for both types); the per-type in-row clauses already match.
